answer: Cross-ridge attestation entropy: voting weight is capped by the number of distinct clusters a grader set spans, found by prism decomposition of its tenancy graph into facets. An attestation counts at full weight only when it crosses a ridge, arriving from a tenancy with its own separately registered egress anchor and an unrelated runtime hash. A farm of k clones sharing one anchor sits inside a single jetty facet, so its joint weight stays one seat however many identities it mints, while one honest agent earns full weight from a single answer.
